title: edritria vulpina
intro: Edritria vulpina, commonly known as Canadian foxglove or red foxglove, is a flowering plant species belonging to the plantain family. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Edritria vulpina are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including glycosides, flavonoids, and iridoid glycosides, which exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat fever, sore throats, and digestive issues.
